answer: At a wharf, shipping agents back up manifests for velvet cargo. Prevent a spiral of fake storage providers by splitting each file into a fixed set of erasure-coded shards and funding one active contract per shard index. A provider must pass unpredictable possession checks against the committed shard before receiving payment. Ten aliases offering the same shard compete for one contract instead of earning ten payouts. This blocks duplicate-storage rewards, but one operator can still hold different shards; resilience to a common outage needs separate safeguards.
